verified_claims.claim: 过表达 MEP 途径+IspA+GGPPS 后紫杉二烯相对单表达 TXS 菌株实现约 83 倍提升
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文摘要与第 6 页 Results
verified_claims.evidence: 'caused an 83-fold increase in the amount of taxadiene produced compared to the strain only expressing TXS'

verified_claims.claim: 三组合株 txs+crtE+SDFHCEGA 总紫杉二烯产量约 17.8 mg/L(OD600≈9,比产率 1.981 mg/L/OD600)
verified_claims.source_locator: 原文摘要与第 9 页 Discussion
verified_claims.evidence: 'The total amount of taxadiene produced by that strain was 17.8 mg.L'; 'The OD600 of this strain was approximately 9; hence, the total production of taxadiene is around 17.8 mg/L'

verified_claims.claim: TXS 蛋白可溶表观分子量约 89 kDa,源自 T. baccata 全长 862 aa,截去 N 端 60 aa(质体定位信号)
verified_claims.evidence: 'a soluble TXS protein (~89 kDa)'; 'a protein of 862 amino acids'; 'a truncated TXS protein eliminating the first 60 amino acids (plastid targeting sequence)'

verified_claims.claim: GC-MS 内标 β-石竹烯保留时间 9.25 min,紫杉二烯保留时间 20.05 min(SIM m/z 122)
verified_claims.evidence: 'the internal standard β-caryophyllene peak at retention time 9.25 min. and the taxadiene peak at retention time 20.05 min'

verified_claims.claim: 30 代无抗生素连续传代后 pDR_txs 与 pBS0E_crtE 保留率 100%,p04_SDFHCEGA 保留率约 90%
verified_claims.evidence: 'showed 100% ability to retain the pDR_txs and pBS0E_crtE constructs until the 30th generation along with 90% ability to retain the p04_SDFHECEGA construct'

verified_claims.claim: 跨文献摇瓶比较:本研究 17.8 mg/L > 酿酒酵母 8.7 mg/L (Engels 2008) > 大肠杆菌 11.3 mg/L (Bian 2017)
verified_claims.evidence: 'higher than the amount reported in yeast 8.7 mg/L (Engels et al., 2008) and in E. coli 11.3 mg/L (Bian et al., 2017) on shake flask fermentation level'

verified_claims.claim: 最佳诱导温度为 20 °C,30 °C 条带极弱,37 °C 无可见可溶 TXS
